title: Chapter 38 Void Battlefield
content:
Chapter 38 Void Battlefield

Wang Shuo came to the wall. The flood receded very quickly. At this time, there was still a half-person-high flood.

On the wooden stake floating in the flood, there was a yellowish-brown puppy.

If you don't look carefully, it's really hard to tell.

"Woof, woof." The puppy saw Wang Shuo and barked twice. The voice was soft and weak.

It seemed to be asking for help, and it seemed to be lamenting that it could survive the disaster.

This puppy naturally ran out of Hadro's shop. It thought it could live a carefree life, but it didn't expect that it would encounter a flood.

It's really hard for a dog!

For the past two days, it has been soaking in the water, cold and hungry. If it hadn't found this wooden stake, it might have died.

At this moment, it missed the time when its owner took care of it.

After this disaster, it was determined to find an owner and never run around again.

And Wang Shuo in front of it seemed to be sent by God to save it, allowing it to see the dawn of survival.

Wang Shuo looked at the small map, and the dog also turned into a yellow light dot.

It was red at first, but now it turned yellow. Wang Shuo was a little confused about the reason.

Wang Shuo thought for a while and ordered the golden armored warrior to drag the wooden stake with the puppy on it.

The puppy was put in the courtyard. At this moment, it didn't even have the strength to stand. It was wet all over, and the wet dog hair and mud were stuck together, which looked very ugly.

"Let's roast it first! If it can survive, roast it by the fire. If it can't survive, roast it on the fire." Wang Shuo said silently.

The feeling of surviving a disaster is not only felt by the dog, but also by Wang Shuo at this moment. He put away the water-proof sky curtain and found that it can be reused. It is really a rare good thing.

In order to reward himself, Wang Shuo directly roasted a sheep that had not been driven back to the farm.

This behavior made the dog by the fire feel a little scared.

After recovering some mobility, it kept a distance from Wang Shuo.

But when the lamb was roasted, it didn't care about being afraid and looked at Wang Shuo eagerly.

Wang Shuo took a bite and it tasted great.

The color was burnt and shiny, not greasy or smelly, and the meat was tender and delicious.

Seeing this, the dog next to him barked, "Woof, woof".

"After eating my roasted lamb leg, you have to listen to me and follow me in the future. Do you hear me clearly?" Wang Shuo joked to the dog.

The dog barked twice again.

At this time, Wang Shuo found that the yellow light dot represented by the dog on the map turned green.

And there was a system prompt.

[Get a pet. ]

"Is this okay?"

Looking at the khaki puppy in front of him, Wang Shuo was a little disgusted and threw the lamb leg he had bitten in his hand to it.

"After eating, you still have to give it a bath." Wang Shuo frowned.

When the dog finished eating the whole lamb leg, Wang Shuo was really surprised. This dog has a big appetite!

"Maybe it's too hungry!"

After it recovered its strength, Wang Shuo gave it a bath with hot water.

"From now on, you'll be called 'Da Huang'!"

Back in the hall, sitting on the armchair, Wang Shuo began to think about his future plans.

The start of the elimination round seemed to hang a sword over the heads of every player.

Although Wang Shuo was a little surprised to be ranked first temporarily, it did not give him a great sense of security.

If he didn't work hard, he would be eliminated sooner or later.

In order to maintain his leading edge, it was time to go to the void battlefield.

The flood outside the house finally subsided, leaving only turbid muddy water in the pond.

Wang Shuo and the golden armor warriors simply cleaned up the traces left by the flood, and moved the farm and farmland to the edge of the pond.

By the way, they fed the chickens and goats. At this moment, the chickens can lay eggs, and the goats can also give birth.

This made Wang Shuo's food source initially stable.

After planting crops in the farmland, he began to pack his backpack and prepare for entering the void battlefield.

After preparing weapons, food and other supplies, he ate a large piece of roasted lamb that he had not finished in the morning.

Wang Shuo came to the gate of the void.

[Do you want to enter the void battlefield? ]

"Yes."

The scene changed, and Wang Shuo felt dizzy.

After a while, Wang Shuo began to notice that he was actually in a vast desert.

"Woof, woof."

Da Huang's voice surprised Wang Shuo. Wang Shuo did not intend to bring Da Huang to adventure here.

It seems that it followed secretly.

The wind around was strong, and some wind and sand were flying in the air, making Wang Shuo unable to open his eyes.

After exploring around, except for the gullies left by the erosion of wind and sand, there were gravel all over the ground.

Wang Shuo felt bad instantly.

He randomly chose a direction and walked a distance.

Wang Shuo found a lot of bones, and some broken weapons and armor were scattered around, but unfortunately they were all unusable.

This was clearly a battlefield, but it was unknown how many years ago the war took place.

It looked like it was quite old.

"Agui, do you know where this is?"

"It looks like a copy."

"Nonsense."

Looking at the creepy scene around him, Wang Shuo was still a little scared. Fortunately, there was a dog accompanying him, giving him the courage to continue exploring.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo discovered that there were red light spots flashing on his map page.

The map at this time shows an area approximately 500 meters in radius.

Wang Shuo was wary and looked to the left. He saw a blurry black figure in the distance, rushing towards Wang Shuo quickly.

Wang Shuo immediately summoned his gold medal fighter, the Golden Armor Warrior, from his backpack.

Soon, the black shadow came to Wang Shuo. Wang Shuo quickly ordered the golden-armored warriors to greet him, but the result was that Wang Shuo stood stunned on the spot!

The black shadow had no entity and penetrated directly.

This made Wang Shuoshuo quite depressed.

Wang Shuo didn't dare to bet whether this black shadow could hurt him.

I quickly checked it with the "Eye of Breaking Delusion".

【ghost】

【grade:? ? ? class】

[Attack power:? ? ? 】

[Defense:? ? 】

[Health value:? ? ? 】

[Skill: Soul Draining, which can cause damage to creatures with souls. 】

[Evaluation: The third-level undead unit in the ancient battlefield has no entity and is immune to physical attacks. 】

It's all a row of question marks, and you can't even see the level. It's obviously much higher than yourself, and it can cause damage to the soul, so you don't become an idiot!

Thinking that Chang Gui also has a soul body, Wang Shuo asked directly: "Agui, do you know this kind of monster? Do you have any way to deal with him?"

After a while, Chang Gui seemed to have remembered it, and suddenly said: "My lord, run! The level of this ghost should be above level 20, but you can try it with the purification scroll!"

Wang Shuo quickly took out the purification scroll and used it on the ghost.

A "-10" number immediately appeared on the ghost's head, which obviously caused damage to it.

But one scroll only caused 10 points of damage, which was simply terrifying.

Wang Shuo only had this purification scroll, so he had no choice but to run away!

Without any time to think, Wang Shuo put the golden-armored warrior into his backpack and ran away.

"Woof, woof."

Wang Shuo saw that Rhubarb was too slow, so he hugged it in his arms and continued running.

At this time, he was wearing crocodile leather boots, and his agility value had reached 9. He was already running very fast, and naturally the dog couldn't catch up.

After running for a while, Wang Shuo found that the ghost did not follow him, so he hid behind a boulder, panting.

Before resting for a moment, Dahuang started barking again.

"You want to die!" Wang Shuo cursed in a low voice. He walked to the boulder and saw that the ghost was chasing after him again.

It’s really haunting!

In desperation, Wang Shuo had no choice but to continue running.

Along the way, Wang Shuo encountered more and more ghosts!

In addition to ghosts, there is also a kind of ghost called injustice, which looks more ferocious.

Some of these monsters wandered alone, while others roamed in groups of three or five in the vast Gobi desert.

Every time he encountered this situation, Wang Shuo could only stay away, but this time, Wang Shuo's luck seemed to have run out.

There were dozens of ghosts and innocent souls in front of him, and nearly ten more followed behind him. He was surrounded.

"I'm sorry."

"It can't be so unlucky!"
